contract.observation: Revision 1 was frozen before observation. B06 exposed an additional derivative MQ3027_InvalidExpressionType when the nested CTE declaration itself was mutated; revision 2 corrected only that candidate construction by mutating the unique outer consumer. Revision 3 changes only the fixtureRef.testName to the permanent matrix test and is the authoritative identity without changing expected diagnostics.

observations.finding: B06 nested CTE declaration mutation produced MQ3001_UnknownColumn plus derivative MQ3027_InvalidExpressionType; the declared single-root oracle was not isolated.
All A, B and C observations matched the corrected contract, including one isolated B06 MQ3001 root; D and E were verified by the permanent matrix.

The authoritative v3 contract changes only the fixture reference from the removed observation helper to CandidateMatrix_ShouldCoverFrozenContract; no expected mutation, diagnostic or observation field changed.

focusedMatrix.coverage: The permanent matrix covers all 24 frozen identifiers. A and B reuse one QueryAnalyzer sequentially; C compares equal query text across two value-distinct BasicSchemaProvider fixtures and repeated invalid analyses; D exercises limits and reset; E copies and formats structured payloads repeatedly. Concurrent sharing is not claimed.

obligations.REC-125-O03: The four D cases exercise DiagnosticBag and DiagnosticContext limits, duplicate identity handling, warning retention and Clear reset while retaining earliest useful roots.
obligations.REC-125-O04: The four E cases copy structured diagnostics through related info, fixes, explanations, documentation, arguments, locations and JSON/text formatting while checking phase, source and locations.
